initialExam.title: IB Security Assistant 2026
initialExam.description: Intelligence Bureau Security Assistant/Executive recruitment for intelligence gathering and security operations. IB is India's internal intelligence agency under MHA.
initialExam.qualifications: Matriculation with knowledge of local language
initialExam.syllabus: GK/Current Affairs, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical/Analytical Ability, English Language.
initialExam.examPattern: Tier I: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Tier II: Descriptive (Translation/Essay). Tier III: Interview/Personality Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Tier I (Online) → Tier II (Descriptive) → Tier III (Interview) → Medical → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Security Assistant/Executive in Intelligence Bureau field units
initialExam.careerGrowth: Security Asst → ACIO-II → ACIO-I → SIO → ADIO → DIO → JD → AD → Director.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mha.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Special Security Allowance, Pension, Risk allowance
